explanation: This Mathlib version has no `Module.IsCoherent`: grepping for `IsCoherent` finds only the topology notion `IsCoherentWith`, and no "Coherent" appears anywhere in Mathlib/RingTheory. The library defines `Module.IsCoherent` itself, so Mathlib cannot contain this local-to-global result for coherent modules. The proof combines several Mathlib lemmas (`Module.Finite.of_localizationSpan'`, `Module.FinitePresentation.of_localizationSpan'`, `Submodule.localized'_fg`) with the library's own lemma `Module.IsCoherent.submodule`. No single Mathlib declaration gives the result.
